newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH INLAND CONTAINER SHIPPING RISES 15 PCT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH INLAND CONTAINER SHIPPING RISES 15 PCT.

text.p: Inland shipping of containers in the Netherlands has grown 15 percent in the past year and the waterways are on course to take 50 percent of the container market by 2005, the inland waterways authority said on Monday.

"Transport of containers remains a success story with growth again at 15 percent.... If this trend continues our aim of 50 percent (of the containering market) in 2005 should be easily achievable," said Ton Roos, director of the Central Bureau of Rhine and Inland Shipping (CBRB)
The policy of increasing the number of terminals within the Netherlands is bearing fruit, he said.
At present, almost 1.5 million TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units) shipped are transported by barge or ship.
